description: A React component for rendering a categorical DeckGL map container with legend and category toggling, used within Apache Superset for geospatial visualizations.

classes.name: CategoricalDeckGLContainer
classes.description: React functional component managing a DeckGL container with categorical data, including color assignment, viewport adjustment, and category toggling.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Computes categories with associated colors based on form data and input data.

methods.name: getAdjustedViewport
methods.description: Calculates the viewport, auto-zooming if enabled.

methods.name: setTooltip
methods.description: Sets tooltip content on the DeckGL container.

methods.name: addColor
methods.description: Adds color information to data points based on selected color scheme.

methods.name: getLayers
methods.description: Generates DeckGL layers based on current data, categories, and form data.

methods.name: toggleCategory
methods.description: Enables or disables a category, with logic to enable all if all are disabled.

methods.name: showSingleCategory
methods.description: Enables only a single category, disabling others.
